<section class="r-lab" data-r-lab="08_within_between_output" aria-label="Recalculate within-between summaries">
<div class="r-lab-heading"><span class="r-lab-badge">Run R</span><h3>Recalculate within-between summaries</h3></div>
<p class="r-lab-note">Uses real aggregate model outputs. A lower clutch SD means greater consistency; a higher fledging component precision means greater consistency.</p>
<label for="r-code-08_within_between_output">Editable R code</label>
<textarea id="r-code-08_within_between_output" class="r-lab-code" spellcheck="false" rows="8">results &lt;- readRDS(&quot;tables/within_between_20261026/aggregate_results.rds&quot;)
print(subset(results$fixed_effects, model == &quot;within_between&quot; &amp;
             term %in% c(&quot;temp_within&quot;, &quot;temp_between&quot;)), row.names = FALSE)
print(results$contrasts, row.names = FALSE)
effects &lt;- results$reference_effects
effects$consistency_change_percent &lt;- 100 * (effects$consistency_ratio_per_C - 1)
print(effects[, c(&quot;trait&quot;, &quot;predictor&quot;, &quot;mean_change_per_C&quot;, &quot;consistency_measure&quot;,
                  &quot;consistency_change_percent&quot;, &quot;ratio_lower&quot;, &quot;ratio_upper&quot;)], row.names = FALSE)
</textarea>
